rule: Local payload presence never widens its oracle classification/use/prohibition. Current Owner decisions and mission overlays supersede conflicting historical clauses.

oracles.name: Current accepted Foundation successor
oracles.use: Resolve the current accepted executable authority identity and current execution state from the single live state file, then inspect the exact accepted artifact/source for executable truth.
oracles.prohibition: Never infer accepted authority from candidates or historical versioned controls. CURRENT_STATE may point to accepted authority but does not replace direct artifact/source inspection when behavior is material.

oracles.name: Library Editor v1.2.17 accepted design donor
oracles.use: Mine actual accepted generic Presentation/Behavior/Interaction value; donor-derived reuse must extract/rebind actual value, not build a parallel lookalike.
oracles.prohibition: Not universal domain authority, final Shell authority, or permanent Library-only implementation island.
oracles.hardGate: Real donor path + real non-Library consumer + state/viewport-matched component proof required.

oracles.name: R3 Golden Library Visual Interaction Parity Matrix
oracles.use: Replay applicable P0 Golden scenarios on real current consumer paths at matching states/viewports.
oracles.prohibition: Pixel identity not required where a newer Owner decision explicitly supersedes the exact chrome; mechanical/accessibility value cannot be lost silently.
oracles.hardGate: Any P0 loss without explicit newer Owner supersession = REJECT.

oracles.name: R3 Golden Browser Scenarios
oracles.use: Scenario receipts must bind to exact current source and real consumer route; fixture-only route cannot satisfy donor parity.
oracles.prohibition: Scenario receipt must match current exact source and applicable state.

oracles.name: Current Owner Decision Live Register
oracles.use: Binding live Owner-decision index. Update in place when durable Owner decisions are added or superseded; every applicable ACTIVE decision requires zero-loss disposition.
oracles.prohibition: Do not infer supersession from style preference or Writer convenience.

oracles.name: W02 Master Product Architecture and Execution Plan
oracles.use: Mine W02 product semantics, surface responsibilities, one-action-home, 1440/1024 hierarchy, Bidi and continuity requirements.
oracles.prohibition: Old Laravel/Vue/PHP paths, branch/SHA, DB proposals and historical runtime observations are not current implementation authority.

oracles.name: W03 Studio identity / architecture durable evidence family
oracles.use: Mine the five-surface W03 causal identity, domain lifecycles, Studio composition and mode ownership. Reconcile through current Owner decisions, the current Final Visual Reference Register, AR2 recovery and exact current source before mission binding.
oracles.prohibition: Not current implementation authority; old Laravel/Vue/PHP paths, branch/SHA state and historical runtime assumptions are historical-only. Operations remains a Runs mode; Replay/AAR/Compare remain Results modes. Never infer global Read/Edit surface semantics from object immutability.

oracles.name: Runtime / Persistence / Bridge Durable Technical Reference
oracles.use: Durable CEP-specific technical constraints, provisional directions and bounded proof gates distilled from the archived 2026-09-14 working memory without stale mission/path authority.
oracles.prohibition: Never treat provisional stack/schema/provider directions as selected authority without current Owner/Controller adjudication and required target proof.

oracles.name: Current Final Visual Reference Register
oracles.use: Resolve exact current final/supporting visual-reference IDs, SHA-256 values and classification ceilings per Surface/state. Use for result-first Presentation comparison together with current Owner decisions and domain/provider truth.
oracles.prohibition: Visual references do not grant implementation, domain/data/provider, merge, release, deployment or product-acceptance authority. Do not copy binaries into live governance; bind by exact pointer/classification.

oracles.name: CEP Final Visual & Interaction Contract — durable UX/IA oracle
oracles.use: Apply durable information-ownership, action-home, contextual-layer, region-ownership, navigation-continuity, responsive and Bidi interaction laws where not superseded.
oracles.prohibition: Do not promote historical Shell chrome, fixed Arabic/RTL/theme defaults, old route topology or historical implementation paths. Newer Owner decisions always overlay/supersede conflicting clauses.

oracles.name: W04 A03 Progress & Evidence approved domain operating model
oracles.use: Bind Candidate Evidence → Evidence → Review → Decision → Mastery State, immutable/superseding revision and decision laws, Mastery causal truth and Portfolio projection/curation boundaries for W04.
oracles.prohibition: Does not authorize historical implementation paths or surface-local shared owners; current shared-family owners and newer Owner decisions remain binding.

oracles.name: W05 System & Operations durable Work Master Plan
oracles.use: Recover W05 surface identity, lifecycle, command/state, provenance, failure/compensation and typed-region value, reconciled against current profiles, current technical reference, current visual register and Owner decisions.
oracles.prohibition: Historical Laravel/PHP/PostgreSQL/queue/schema/path assumptions are not current implementation authority; Processing remains contract-derivable with no fabricated reference image.

oracles.name: 23 Surface Zero-Loss Identity / Reference / Current-Owner Matrix
oracles.use: Mandatory Controller synthesis for post-M0 rescue mission design: bind every Surface purpose, workbench, command/lifecycle model, reference ceiling, shared-owner dependencies, current admitted gaps and Owner overlays before mutation.
oracles.prohibition: Does not accept M0, promote readiness, freeze stack or authorize mutation by itself. Exact Writer mission/parent/scope/output binding remains required.

oracles.name: E19 rejected Presentation execution evidence
oracles.use: Prevent recurrence of fixture-as-consumer, parallel lookalike extraction, permissive audit aggregation and hidden visual evidence.
oracles.prohibition: Never treat E19 convergence-ready token as current Presentation authority.
